text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-112233 — hosted-api 5xx spike in eu-west-1. Trigger: 5xx rate > 0.5% over 60s. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-112233

maria: Acked via PD. I'm oncall and will take this. Pulling logs and checking autoscaler + recent deploys.

lee: ping — seeing queue depth or pod churn? any obvious tail latencies?

maria: quick summary: spike concentrated on model-serving pool "embedder-prod-eu". 95p latency jumped 2.1s -> 7.8s, error-rate ~0.9%. Rolling deploy completed ~12m ago. Investigating rollout + readiness failures.

jordan: @maria can we short-circuit noisy clients with an ingress throttle while we triage? reduces amplification.

maria: doing a targeted rollback and scale up now:
```
kubectl scale deployment embedder-prod-eu --replicas=12
kubectl rollout undo deploy/embedder-prod-eu --to-revision=3
```
Will watch pod readiness for 60s.

incidentbot: Note: autoscaler is reporting inhibited scaling during incident window.

lee: I can see a single customer key (cust-acme-123) accounting for ~65% of recent requests. @customer_success can you confirm if they started a batch?

customer_success: Confirmed. ACME kicked off large batch jobs at ~10:30 UTC, ~7x normal traffic. I'm reaching out to get them to pause.

sre_lead: maria — if rollback doesn't stabilize in 2m, plan B: switch to quantized variant and enable prefix/KV cache fallback. Prefer avoiding full outage.

maria: rollback in progress. 60s in: replacing failing pod instances, 95p latency trending toward 3.0s, error-rate down to ~0.5%.

jordan: applying quick ingress rate-limit for embed endpoints:
```
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps: "50"
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-burst: "100"
```

maria: rate-limit applied. errors ~0.2%, 95p ~1.4s. Metrics look much improved. Monitoring for any residual failures.

incidentbot: PD status updated: Acknowledged by maria. Severity downgraded to Sev2 — customer impact reduced. Estimated full mitigation: 15m.

maria: I'll hand this off to lee in 15m. Notes for handoff: rolled back to rev3, scaled to 12 replicas, ingress rate-limit applied. If errors resurface escalate to "slo-fallback" and open bridge.

lee: taking over in 15m for monitoring and post-incident cleanup. Thanks. @customer_success please confirm ACME pauses their batches.

customer_success: ACME agreed to pause for 10m and will throttle jobs. Will post updates if they resume early.

sre_lead: good mitigation. Action items: add per-customer burst circuit and prompt-length guardrail in follow-up. Tag this for postmortem.

maria: will close PD after stable 30m window. Leaving last check at +15m.

lee: noted — collecting logs for the postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
